> Generated by stewards from `.stewards/units/setup.toml`; change prose through the documenter.

# setup: Onboarding and generated files\: init proposes units and writes .stewards, the guide and AGENTS.md block, the per-harness facts table, and docs rendering from unit cards.

## Overview

The setup unit is how a repository gets onto stewards and how the generated files stay true. It proposes units for a repo and writes .stewards, writes the stewards block into AGENTS.md, tells each agent harness how to delegate, and renders human documentation pages from the unit cards. A reader meets it as four commands: init, guide, and docs, plus the harness table that guide and init draw on.

## How it works

Plain init (src/init.rs, propose) refuses with already_initialized if units.toml or repo.toml exists. Otherwise it proposes units from manifest roots, source directories and co-change history, writes both files, appends any missing .gitignore lines, upserts the AGENTS.md block, and reports the units, the unowned files and the paths it wrote. init --draft (draft_jobs) runs only the first step on an uninitialized repo and then briefs jobs: one architect job to name the units, plus a first-review maintainer job for each unit that has never been reviewed. With --direct it checks every model guard first, then calls and submits each job itself; if one fails it reports how many were already submitted. init --hooks and init --ci return not_implemented. The AGENTS.md block comes from src/guide.rs: upsert_block writes it at the top of the file (creating the file) or replaces the text between the existing start and end markers, and returns whether the file changed, so a rerun is a no-op. guide's run prints the ritual, roles, editing and hygiene paragraphs plus delegation text for the harness forced with --harness or else detected, falling back to generic text; --all adds every harness, --errors the error-code table, --glossary the glossary. src/harness.rs holds the facts table: detect returns the first harness whose env var prefix matches the environment (a harness with an unverified env rule is never detected), and by_name looks one up case-insensitively, failing with harness_unknown and the list of valid names. src/docs.rs (pages) renders docs_path/&lt;unit>.md for one or all units, plus README.md, from the cards, tests and repo.toml. It escapes card text, links live anchors, rejects an empty docs_path or one that escapes the repo, rejects an unknown unit, and writes only files whose content changed.

## How to change it

Start from the file for the command: src/init.rs for proposing units and draft jobs, src/guide.rs for the AGENTS.md block and guide text, src/harness.rs for per-harness facts, src/docs.rs for rendered pages. Each has a test file in tests/ (init.rs, init_draft.rs, guide.rs, docs.rs); change the test with the behavior. Keep true what the contracts promise: plain init never overwrites an initialized repo; init --draft only runs on an uninitialized repo and checks every model guard before any --direct call; upsert_block stays idempotent and touches only the text between its markers; a harness is only detected when its env rule is verified, and an unknown name stays harness_unknown with the valid names; docs refuses a docs_path that is empty or escapes the repo and rewrites only changed files. Keep the card's interface table in step when a contract changes.
